name: dshope-plugins
description: Claude Code skills and hooks from daily use, many built to prevent a specific failure

plugins.name: git-guards
plugins.description: Commit and push skills that work from the real diff, plus a hook that blocks fragile heredoc commit messages

plugins.name: voice-loop
plugins.description: Export drafts to clean paste-ready files, then log how you revised them so Claude learns your voice from your own edits

plugins.name: setup-audit
plugins.description: Audit a CLAUDE.md for bloat and contradictions, and mine your session transcripts for skills worth building

plugins.name: obsidian-guards
plugins.description: Block markdown writes containing tokens that break Obsidian rendering (enable it per vault project)
